<div class="data-dict">

| Variable | Description | Type | Units | Permitted Values | Missing Values | Source |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :---: | :--- | :--- | :---: |
| Sex | The gender of the lifter | Character | N/A | M, F, Mx | None | OpenPowerlifting.org |
| Event | Contest type for each entry | Character | N/A | SBD, B, D, S, BD, SB, SD | None | OpenPowerlifting.org |
| Equipment | Equipment used to assist with lifts | Character | N/A | Raw, Wraps, Single-ply, Multi-ply, Unlimited, Straps | None | OpenPowerlifting.org |
| Tested | Indicates whether an athlete was drug tested | Character | N/A | Yes, or "" (No) | Missing data represents a lack of testing | OpenPowerlifting.org |
| Age | Lifter age at competition date | Numeric | Years | 0–100+ (.5 for estimated ages) | N/A when birthdays are missing | OpenPowerlifting.org |
| BodyweightLbs | Recorded body mass in pounds (lbs) | Numeric | Pounds (lbs) | > 0 | N/A when weigh-in was unrecorded | OpenPowerlifting.org |
| Squat1Lbs | First squat attempt weight | Numeric | Pounds (lbs) | > 0 | N/A for no attempt | OpenPowerlifting.org |
| Squat2Lbs | Second squat attempt weight | Numeric | Pounds (lbs) | > 0 | N/A for no attempt | OpenPowerlifting.org |
| Squat3Lbs | Third squat attempt weight | Numeric | Pounds (lbs) | > 0 | N/A for no attempt | OpenPowerlifting.org |
| Best3SquatLbs | Highest successful attempt in squat | Numeric | Pounds (lbs) | > 0 | N/A for no attempt | OpenPowerlifting.org |
| Bench1Lbs | First bench attempt weight | Numeric | Pounds (lbs) | > 0 | N/A for no attempt | OpenPowerlifting.org |
| Bench2Lbs | Second bench attempt weight | Numeric | Pounds (lbs) | > 0 | N/A for no attempt | OpenPowerlifting.org |
| Bench3Lbs | Third bench attempt weight | Numeric | Pounds (lbs) | > 0 | N/A for no attempt | OpenPowerlifting.org |
| Best3BenchLbs | Highest successful attempt in bench | Numeric | Pounds (lbs) | > 0 | N/A for no attempt | OpenPowerlifting.org |
| Deadlift1Lbs | First deadlift attempt weight | Numeric | Pounds (lbs) | > 0 | N/A for no attempt | OpenPowerlifting.org |
| Deadlift2Lbs | Second deadlift attempt weight | Numeric | Pounds (lbs) | > 0 | N/A for no attempt | OpenPowerlifting.org |
| Deadlift3Lbs | Third deadlift attempt weight | Numeric | Pounds (lbs) | > 0 | N/A for no attempt | OpenPowerlifting.org |
| Best3DeadliftLbs | Highest successful attempt in deadlift | Numeric | Pounds (lbs) | > 0 | N/A for no attempt | OpenPowerlifting.org |
| TotalLbs | Sum of all successful lifts together | Numeric | Pounds (lbs) | > 0 | N/A for no attempt | OpenPowerlifting.org |
| Dots | Bodyweight-normalized strength score | Numeric | Points | > 0 | N/A for missing bodyweight / total lbs | OpenPowerlifting.org |
| Wilks | Legacy bodyweight-normalized strength coefficient | Numeric | Points | > 0 | N/A for missing bodyweight / total lbs | OpenPowerlifting.org |
| Date | Starting date of competition | Date | YYYY-MM-DD | Calendar dates | None | OpenPowerlifting.org |
| Country | Home country of lifter | Character | N/A | Country names (Canada, USA, etc.) | N/A when unrecorded | OpenPowerlifting.org |
| State | Home state, province, or territory of lifter | Character | N/A | State/province (ON, NB, CA) | N/A when unrecorded | OpenPowerlifting.org |
</div>
